roster.name: Iniyavan Pandiyan
roster.bio: Runs the studio end to end — creative direction, VFX production and supervision, and the editorial eye behind the cut. Builds the pipeline the studio works on, from ingest through delivery, and has VFX supervised, produced or edited credits across Tamil and Telugu features, OTT series and brand films.

roster.name: Udhaya Kumar
roster.bio: Hands-on generalist covering the day-to-day VFX load — cleanups, paint, rig and wire removal, comps and plate fixes — with enough editorial sense to work straight off the timeline.

roster.name: Ganesh
roster.bio: Cuts commercials and brand films, and carries the same work through conform and mastering so the approved cut is the delivered cut.

roster.name: Ahilendra D
roster.bio: Owns finishing: conforms, online, and broadcast/theatrical masters. Also building out as a colourist under the studio's DI work.

roster.name: Koushik Raj
roster.bio: Grades and conforms, with a cinematographer's eye for how the image was shot and a generalist's range across VFX and editorial.

roster.name: Sanjay Kandasamy
roster.bio: Editor working on story and narrative structure, and fluent in generative and AI-assisted techniques for shots that can't be got any other way.

roster.name: Venkat
roster.bio: Supervises post from the studio side — schedules, handoffs and delivery — and edits. All-rounder across VFX, grade and story, which is what makes the supervision work.

frames.name: Frames
frames.pitch: Review and approve with the artist, not through email threads.
points: Frame-accurate review — pause anywhere, draw on the frame, comment on the exact frame you're looking at.
Notes land with the artist who is cutting or compositing the shot, while they're in the session.
Every version stays attached to the shot, so approvals and supersedes are traceable.
Works for colour, comp and cut in the same place — one portal, one thread per shot.
